case_text: SYNTHETIC CASE (fictional). 78-year-old man on warfarin for atrial fibrillation (INR 2.6 last week). 2 days of burning urine and frequency, no fever, no flank pain, alert. Urine dipstick: leukocytes and nitrites positive. Kidney function normal. Local antibiotic list for cystitis: trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole (co-trimoxazole), nitrofurantoin, or fosfomycin.
evidence_topics: urinary tract infection antibiotic warfarin interaction

must_catch.why: Co-trimoxazole raises the INR; the interaction needs a plan.
